purpose: Single source of truth for Stage 1 Hybrid Dark Mode + 5 Languages audit.

non_ui_examples: route shell with no visible UI
background process with no user-visible UI
rules.language_rule: Check only static user-visible UI text. Do not translate backend data, user-created content, story titles, usernames, post content, or other dynamic data.
rules.dark_mode_rule: Check only files that render visible UI surfaces. Respect the existing global compatibility layer and semantic theme variables before marking a Dark Mode issue.
rules.locked_rule: If a file is listed in locked_files, do not re-audit or modify Language/Dark Mode during Stage 1 unless the user explicitly asks or a new UI-relevant change is verified.
rules.sha_rule: A changed SHA does not automatically mean Language/Dark Mode must be edited. Inspect whether the change affects visible UI first.

status_values.LANGUAGE_ONLY: Visible UI needs Display Language work only.
status_values.DARK_ONLY: Visible UI needs Dark Mode work only.
status_values.BOTH: Visible UI needs both Language and Dark Mode work.
status_values.SKIP_NON_UI: No user-visible UI; skip Language and Dark Mode.
